Convert single or multiple OST files to PST, PDF, MBOX, EML, MSG, CSV, and more, or import directly to Gmail, Office 365, Thunderbird, and other email services. Features include batch conversion, duplicate email removal, date-range filtering, PST splitting, attachment management, and preview support while preserving folder hierarchy and data integrity.

records.name: MergeMe
records.tagline: Take GitHub/GitLab code reviews directly to Slack.
records.description: Mirror every pull and merge request into Slack as a single, updating card per PR or MR. No notification spam, no broken @mentions, no tab juggling and most importantly - less time wasted while waiting for someone to review your work. Supports GitHub.com, GitLab.com & GitLab Self Hosted from day 1.

records.name: LockdownKeys — Chrome Extension
records.tagline: AES-256 team password manager — now with Chrome Extension
records.description: Lock Down Keys is a zero-knowledge, AES-256-GCM encrypted password manager built for teams. Get shared vaults, one-click offboarding when someone leaves, full audit logs, and a Chrome extension for seamless autofill. A secure, simple alternative to Bitwarden, 1Password, and Dashlane — try free for 14 days, no credit card required.

records.name: NutriChef 11-Piece Cookware
records.tagline: Is it worth $131.99? Real performance, pros & cons.
records.description: Thinking about switching to ceramic? Our comprehensive NutriChef 11-Piece Ceramic Cookware Set review breaks down everything you need to know. We dive deep into its real-world cooking performance, non-stick durability, pros, and cons. Find out if this stylish set is truly worth its $131.99 price tag or if you should look elsewhere before upgrading your kitchen. Read our unbiased verdict before making your choice!

records.name: Cities by Origio
records.tagline: Compare salaries, rent, tax and visas across 90+ cities
records.description: Origio started as a country matching tool. This launch is about cities. Compare 90+ cities by salary after tax, rent, monthly costs, visa routes and side-by-side comparisons. Built for professionals choosing where income and life work best before moving abroad.

records.name: Personal Portfolio-Manas Bhatia
records.tagline: Shipping high performance websites APIs and automation tools
records.description: Welcome to my digital workspace! I'm a full-stack developer specializing in Next.js, FastAPI, and cloud-native AWS deployments. This portfolio explores my recent work—from building internal automated sales tools that integrate complex logistics APIs to launching custom software packages that scale fast. Check out the live projects and let me know what you think!

records.name: puxapena
records.tagline: Compare preços no Mercado Livre, Shopee e Amazon de uma vez
records.description: PuxaPena compara preços no Mercado Livre, Shopee e Amazon simultaneamente. Em vez de abrir 3 abas separadas, você digita o produto uma vez e vê onde está mais barato em segundos. Gratuito, sem criar conta. Focado nos 3 maiores marketplaces do Brasil para um resultado mais limpo e direto.

records.name: ADAMANT Market-Making Software
records.tagline: Self-hosted market-making software for token issuers
records.description: We’re launching ADAMANT Market-Making Software — a self-hosted open-source toolkit for token issuers and crypto projects that want to improve CEX market quality without sending tokens, funds, or API keys to a third-party market maker. We believe projects should not have to hand over custody or control just to make their market usable. • Order book building • Spread and Liquidity support • Reference price / arbitrage logic We’d love feedback from token issuers, and exchange teams.

records.name: The College Agent
records.tagline: Your personal AI for all 4 years of college.
records.description: The College Agent is a personal AI companion that grows with you from freshman orientation to graduation day (and then some!). It manages your classes, professors, internship pipeline, and career - and remembers everything so you never start over.

records.name: AutoReplyPro Inbox Live Chat Add-On
records.tagline: Shared WhatsApp Inbox with Live Chat & Team Collaboration
records.description: Centralize WhatsApp conversations with a powerful shared inbox, live chat, and contact management system. Enable real-time customer support, team collaboration, lead tracking, and faster response times with AutoReply Pro.

records.name: MyLastop
records.tagline: Learn by answering questions, not by rereading!
records.description: An AI-powered platform for students, educators, and professionals to create interactive quizzes and games from their study materials.

records.name: Task Session
records.tagline: Self-Hosted CRM to Manage Clients, Projects, and Payments
records.description: Task Session was built for teams tired of SaaS lock-ins, rising per-seat costs, and storing business data on third-party platforms. It gives agencies, freelancers, and teams a self-hosted CRM they fully own, with unlimited users, clients, projects, tasks, invoices, time tracking, files, and collaboration in one place. Buy once, host on your own server, keep your data private, and manage work with total freedom.

records.name: Cold-to-Cooked: AI Fridge Recipes
records.tagline: Scan your fridge, get AI-powered recipes instantly
records.description: Tired of staring at your fridge with no idea what to cook? Cold-to-Cooked uses AI to scan your ingredients from a photo and instantly generates recipes you can actually make. No more wasted food, no more takeout because you "had nothing to cook." Supports multi-photo scanning, meal tracking, and a health tracker. Free to download.

records.name: Adrex AI
records.tagline: Your ads, on autopilot — run them from your AI
records.description: Adrex AI brings ad management into the AI era. Connect Google & Meta, then run everything from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or Gemini through our open-source MCP server — 54 tools, one API key, zero setup. Or let the autonomous agent optimize budgets, pause losers, and refresh creative 24/7, behind guardrails and an approval queue you control. The dashboard is optional - your AI assistant is the interface. TikTok, LinkedIn and more coming soon.

records.name: Bitcoin-Safe v2.0.0
records.tagline: The Private Bitcoin wallet sync without a third-party server
records.description: WHAT'S NEW: 1. Private chain sync via Compact Block Filters: syncs directly from Bitcoin Core peers, no Electrum server, no address leakage. Most lightweight wallets leak your addresses to a third-party server; this one doesn't 2. Guided setup wizard: rebuilt for newcomers, with device-specific instructions for each supported signer 3. New hardware support: Trezor Safe 7, Jade BT, Passport Prime, COLDCARD Mk5 4. Plugin architecture: GPG-signed external plugins for power users and businesses

records.name: Expenzey Scout
records.tagline: AI-powered WooCommerce insights
records.description: Most WooCommerce store owners have plenty of data but little clarity. Revenue, orders, products, and reviews are scattered across reports, making it hard to see what’s really happening. Expenzey Scout brings AI-powered insights directly into WordPress. Get weekly business reports, uncover trends, analyze customer reviews, chat with your store data & discover growth opportunities - all on a unified dashboard. Scout helps you spend less time reading reports & more time making better decisions.

records.name: Poker Trainer A
records.tagline: Play poker hands, get graded, and fix your leaks with AI
records.description: Poker Trainer AI is a poker training platform where you play Texas Hold’em against AI opponents with different personalities. Every decision is graded in real time using core concepts like position, pot odds, ranges, and EV. After each hand, you review a street-by-street breakdown and learn what you did right or wrong. The system tracks your Poker IQ and highlights leaks over time. Unlike solvers, it focuses on learning through play, not memorization.

records.name: Autlantic
records.tagline: Crypto membership platform for creators
records.description: Autlantic, a crypto membership platform for creators. You get your own storefront, sell USDT subscriptions, manage members and plans, and receive payments directly in your Tron wallet. We don't hold your member revenue. Telegram is built in for creators who want it: group access, broadcasts, and member notifications. But the core product is the membership business itself. For more details please check "How it Works" https://autlantic.com/how-it-works

records.name: ZoroBiz
records.tagline: Run your entire business from one platform
records.description: Run invoices, attendance, payroll, expenses, inventory, EHS safety, purchase orders, and field teams from one ZoroBiz platform. ZoroBiz is an all-in-one business management platform that helps companies streamline accounting, invoicing, payroll, inventory, purchasing, field operations, and EHS compliance. Replace multiple disconnected tools with one secure, cloud-based solution that improves productivity, reduces manual work, and gives your team complete visibility across business operations.

records.name: PureLens
records.tagline: Scan QR & barcodes. Organize in lists. Export to CSV.
records.description: PureLens is the ultimate QR & barcode scanner for iPhone and iPad — built for speed, privacy, and real productivity. 🔍 Instant scanning of QR codes, EAN, UPC, and ISBN — even in low light. 📋 Organize your scans into custom lists (e.g. "Warehouse A", "Summer Event"). 📊 Export to CSV with one tap — ready for Excel or any spreadsheet app. ⚡ Batch Mode: scan 50+ items without stopping. 🔒 100% local — no ads, no data collection. One-time purchase for Pro. No subscriptions. Available on iOS 17+.

records.name: MindRecruiter AI Agent
records.tagline: The only recruiting AI that shows its unfiltered thinking
records.description: Most AI give you an answer. MindRecruiter gives you the thinking first. Paste a Job Description or candidate profile. Watch it reason out loud — Hypothesis, Red Flag, Wild Card, Next Move — raw and unfiltered. Then get the polished, HR-safe conclusion you'd actually say in a meeting. Two voices, one mind. The gap between them is where the real insight lives. Free preview, no login. Private tokens for more. Nothing stored, ever. Private beta — try it, break it, tell us what surprised you.

records.name: YOS ERP
records.tagline: ERP that allows you manage entire business from one place
records.description: **Advanced ERP for Merchandise Companies** ERP.YOS.SO is a powerful cloud-based ERP built for merchandise businesses. Manage inventory, sales, purchases, customers, suppliers, invoicing, and financial reports from one platform. Gain real-time insights, reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and streamline daily operations. Designed to help businesses save time, increase efficiency, and grow with confidence.

records.name: Scrapels
records.tagline: Done-for-you web scraping and data collection services
records.description: Scrapels builds custom web scraping and data automation solutions for businesses that need reliable data at scale. Unlike generic scraping tools, we design and maintain scrapers tailored to your exact sources — e-commerce sites, news, business directories, etc. We handle the full pipeline: target analysis, custom script development, testing, and delivery in CSV, Excel, or Google Sheets. Set it up once and get fresh data on autopilot, with respectful rate-limiting and reliability built in.

records.name: Atlas Core
records.tagline: One unified platform for horticultural resources management
records.description: Atlas Core is a complete ERP system built specifically for ornamental horticulture. It's the software that runs a plant business end to end — your catalogue and stock, the customers you sell to, the orders and invoices that flow through, and the day-to-day operations behind all of it. This isn't a generic retail or inventory tool bolted onto plants: the vocabulary, workflows and features - plant passports, propagation, growing protocols and batch traceability.

records.name: Nyx AI
records.tagline: Free AI workspace to draft emails, captions, and summaries
records.description: Nyx AI is a lightning-fast content assistant built for creators, students, and professionals. It instantly drafts professional emails, optimizes social captions with smart hashtags, condenses heavy threads into crisp bullet summaries, and polishes grammar perfectly—all from one clean interface powered by state-of-the-art models via Lovable AI.

records.name: CV Builder online
records.tagline: Actually free resume builder — no paywall at download
records.description: Most "free" resume builders hide a paywall behind the download button. CV Builder online doesn't. Build your resume through a guided quiz instead of a blank page, pick an ATS-friendly template, run it through the built-in ATS checker, add a matching cover letter, and export to PDF — all in one place. AI helps with summaries and bullet points when you're stuck. Available in 5 languages. Made by a solo maker to help people land jobs, not subscriptions.

records.name: AllDayToolkit
records.tagline: 100+ free online tools — no sign-up, runs in your browser
records.description: 112+ free online tools for PDF, images, text, calculators, converters, AI and developers. Fast and private — everything runs in your browser, nothing uploaded — and free with no sign-up.

records.name: DocMetrics Silence Checker
records.tagline: Know what buyers do with your proposal after you hit send
records.description: Sales teams often treat every silent buyer the same, leading to generic follow-ups and missed opportunities. DocMetrics helps you understand what buyers are actually doing after a proposal is sent by revealing engagement patterns, repeat views, stakeholder activity, and proposal behavior. This launch also includes the free Silence Checker, which helps sales reps interpret buyer silence and choose a more informed follow-up instead of relying on guesswork.

records.name: Doppelbot
records.tagline: Your own AI, at your own address
records.description: Doppelbot gives you a personal AI at yourname.doppelbot.ai that answers as you, 24/7. Upload your CV, set your boundaries, share the link. Job seekers use it as an interactive resume recruiters can interview, that captures their details too. Free to start.
